faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCDC Bihar Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 10 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in Computer/IT and possess 3 years of experience in data management, process documentation, and web-based reporting.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 37 years and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 13500.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the WCDC Bihar Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is 01/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and download the application form from the official website: https://nawada.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual job opportunity.
